criteria.statement: A valid signed RELEASE result registers exactly one immutable digest-only artifact with complete lineage, while exact replay converges and conflicting replay fails closed.
Invalid signature, unknown worker, wrong repository/workflow/trigger/review policy, missing descriptors, digest mismatch, and replay conflict are rejected without artifact or desired-state mutation.
CI registration alone creates no promotion intent and changes no environment desired state.

An RBAC-authorized bahia.deploy.v2 service/deploy request bound to the registered release, staged canary environment, previous digest, rollback metadata, and health/readiness contracts creates one digest-only canary.

Pending, unauthorized, invalid, and conflicting promotion decisions do not create a canary or unauthorized desired-state change, and every registration/promotion decision emits signed kind-4903 outbox evidence.
